title: tokens.create
description: What making an API token takes: its name, the resources it reaches, and the roles it holds there. It acts for whoever makes it.

resources.description: What it reaches, each a resource pattern: acme/agent/* for acme's own agents, acme/@jon/* for everything of a user's, acme/* for everything of the org's and its users', acme/agent/triage for one agent, or * for everything.

roles.description: What it may do there, each a named set of actions.

policy.description: The policy every agent it defines runs under, ahead of the agent's own, by the name the server holds it under: what IAM calls a permissions boundary. The token making it names its own where this is left out.

expires_in.description: How many seconds it works for; the server's own lifetime for API tokens, 90 days unless set, where left out.
